people.name: Ahijah
people.line: Levite in charge of the treasuries of the temple

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
translations.bsb: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.
translations.kjv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
translations.asv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
